_comment: Sprint 0 (Switchboard Plan) — shared scenario taxonomy: the departments/leaves a call can be classified into, alongside the existing role/difficulty/pace coaching data. Single source for BOTH the client (src/lib/scenario-taxonomy.ts) and the server (server/scenario-taxonomy.mjs, classifyScenario step), same split as coaching.json. `standardization` (high/medium/low) is the badge from the plan doc — it's what later sprints use to decide how much a leaf can be prebuilt. `examples` are short reference phrasings for the classifier prompt, not UI copy.

appt.doctor_dentist.label: Book a doctor / dentist visit
examples: I need to book a dentist appointment
歯医者の予約を取りたい
I want to see a doctor next week

appt.restaurant.label: Book a restaurant table
examples: I want to reserve a table for 4
レストランの予約をしたい

appt.salon_laser.label: Book a salon / laser hair removal clinic
examples: I want to book a laser hair removal session
美容脱毛の予約をしたい

appt.cancel_reschedule.label: Cancel or reschedule an appointment
examples: I need to cancel my appointment
予約を変更したい
I have to reschedule my booking

medical.symptom_common.label: Symptom call: sore throat, fever, rash, dizziness
examples: I have a fever and sore throat
熱があって喉が痛い
I feel dizzy and need to see someone

medical.symptom_sti.label: Symptom call: suspected STI
examples: I'm worried I might have an STI and need a test

medical.symptom_injury.label: Symptom call: soreness, broken bone, cut needing stitches
examples: I think I broke my arm
I have a deep cut that might need stitches
腕を骨折したかもしれない

medical.symptom_skin_concern.label: Symptom call: skin infection, worrying mole or cancer concern
examples: I have a mole that looks different and I'm worried
I think I have a skin infection

banking.lost_card.label: Report a lost or stolen card, request reissue
examples: I lost my credit card and need to report it
カードを紛失したので止めてほしい

housing.rent.label: Rent question or payment issue
examples: I have a question about my rent payment
家賃について相談したい

housing.urgent_damage.label: Urgent damage: fire, earthquake, water leak
examples: There's a water leak in my apartment
水漏れがあった
There was a fire in my building and I need to tell the landlord

housing.other_damage.label: Other, unnamed apartment damage
examples: Something broke in my apartment and I don't know how to explain it

gov.general.label: General city hall call (reception / claims / accounts)
examples: I need to call city hall about a form
役所に電話したい

gov.tax.label: Resident tax questions
examples: I have a question about my resident tax bill
住民税について聞きたい

gov.address_registration.label: Address registration (move in / move out)
examples: I need to register my new address
転入届を出したい

gov.home_purchase.label: Home purchase registration
examples: I bought a house and need to register it

gov.mynumber_card.label: Lost My Number card, reissue
examples: I lost my My Number card and need a new one
マイナンバーカードを紛失した
